scope: Narrow preservation of three accepted boundaries after namespace source correction; no new acceptance count.

fresh-render.limit: Source/owner/question/visible alternative routing, static SVG and deterministic render checks only; not per-edge semantic or human screenreader acceptance.

browser-qa.limit: Actual SVG loading, widths, native keyboard horizontal scrolling and visible alternative destinations; not semantic edge or human screenreader acceptance.

sources.limit: Primary source object/revision/line or Markdown-fragment verification only; not semantic or live-runtime acceptance.

parentVisualInspection: Current full natural namespace diagram inspected: all labels/arrows/expiry-finalizer split readable; mobile/native focus+horizontal scrolling tested at three widths. No humanAT or live cleanup result.
